title: Echo-CoPilot: A Multiple-Perspective Agentic Framework for Reliable Echocardiography Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2512.09944v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Echocardiography interpretation requires integrating multi-view temporal evidence with quantitative measurements and guideline-grounded reasoning, yet existing foundation-model pipelines largely solve isolated subtasks and fail when tool outputs are noisy or values fall near clinical cutoffs. We propose Echo-CoPilot, an end-to-end agentic framework that combines a multi-perspective workflow with knowledge-graph-guided measurement selection. Echo-CoPilot runs three independent ReAct-style agents, structural, pathological, and quantitative, that invoke specialized echocardiography tools to extract parameters while querying EchoKG to determine which measurements are required for the clinical question and which should be avoided. translated_title: Echo-CoPilot：一种用于可靠超声心动图解读的多视角智能体框架
translated_abstract: 超声心动图解读需要将多视角时间证据与定量测量以及基于临床指南的推理相结合，然而现有的基础模型流程大多只解决孤立的子任务，当工具输出存在噪声或数值接近临床临界值时便会失效。我们提出了Echo-CoPilot，这是一个端到端的智能体框架，将多视角工作流与知识图谱引导的测量选择相结合。Echo-CoPilot运行三个独立的ReAct风格智能体——结构性、病理性和定量性智能体——它们调用专门的超声心动图工具来提取参数，同时查询EchoKG知识图谱，以确定针对临床问题需要哪些测量指标以及应避免哪些测量指标。随后，一个自对比语言模型对各基于证据的视角进行比较，生成差异检查清单，并重新查询EchoKG以应用适当的指南阈值、解决视角间的冲突……
tldr: Echo-CoPilot是一个端到端的智能体框架，通过三个独立的ReAct式多视角智能体（结构、病理、定量）结合知识图谱EchoKG引导的测量选择与自对比冲突消解机制，实现可靠且符合临床指南的超声心动图解读。
en_tdlr: Echo-CoPilot is an end-to-end agentic framework that employs three independent ReAct-style multi-perspective agents (structural, pathological, and quantitative) with knowledge-graph-guided measurement selection via EchoKG and self-contrast conflict resolution to achieve reliable, guideline-grounded echocardiography interpretation.
